_doc: How far a ship rolls into a turn, the view's only (owner, 2026-11-12: "when ship turns it needs to roll a little. 30 degrees for small ship, 20 degrees for medium ship, 10 degrees for large ship", "if turning, slerp to roll angle (for 5 seconds), if stop turning slerp roll angle back to 0"). A ship's size is read from how fast its class turns (a frigate's 36-46 deg/s, a destroyer's or cruiser's 26-35, a capital's 24 or less). A turn of less than min_order_deg still to go is not rolled into (owner, 2026-11-12: "avoid rolling if turning order is too small an angle (less than 2 degrees dont roll)"). Read by src/Game/View/BattleView.Bank.cs.
